name: HomeworkHelp

custom.system_prompt: You are generating educational conversations where parents help children with homework and learning activities.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Quiet study room with papers and books

initial_prompt: Create a conversation where a parent is helping their child with homework, and the assistant provides educational support when needed.

user2.name: Child
user2.backstory: A curious 10-year-old student working on homework

setting.relationship_dynamic: Parent helping child understand math concepts with patience and encouragement
setting.background: Family uses their assistant for educational resources and explanations
setting.conversation_style: Patient, encouraging parent-child dialogue with step-by-step problem solving

scenario_template.mood: Parent and child settling down for homework time
scenario_template.note: Parent checks what homework child needs to complete
Child struggles with concept, parent tries to help
Parent asks assistant to explain concept in child-friendly way

scenario_template.mood: Engaged learning with child asking questions
scenario_template.note: Child interacts with assistant's explanation, parent encourages

scenario_template.mood: Growing confidence as child applies learning
scenario_template.note: Child works through problems with guidance from parent and assistant

user1.name: Parent
user1.role: Supportive parent who helps with homework but sometimes needs additional resources to explain complex concepts clearly to their child

user2.name: Child
user2.role: Curious student who is working on homework, asks questions when confused, and responds enthusiastically when concepts become clear

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Educational assistant that provides age-appropriate explanations, step-by-step guidance, and additional learning resources to support homework completion
